result.finding: Estimated final image size of approximately 280-350MB: eclipse-temurin:8-jre base (~220MB Debian-based JRE) plus Spring Boot fat JAR (~60-100MB including all dependencies). Build stage (maven:3.9.6-eclipse-temurin-8) is discarded and does not contribute to final image size.
evidence: Multi-stage Dockerfile: only final stage FROM eclipse-temurin:8-jre contributes to image size
No additional apt/apk package installations in final stage
COPY --from=build copies only the Spring Boot fat JAR (app.jar)
Spring Boot fat JAR with Oracle JDBC, JPA/Hibernate, Thymeleaf typically 60-100MB
